# spec

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/spec"
```

Package spec holds what every generator in docgen reads: a field's shape, its meaning, and the resolved entry pairing them. It imports nothing, so the generators depend on it without depending on each other.

<a name="Describe"></a>
## func [Describe](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/spec/reflect.go#L36>)

```go
func Describe(v any, recursionLimit ...int) ([]Field, MetadataSource, error)
```

Describe returns v's documented fields and the metadata every type along the way declares, so a nested struct declares its fields once. recursionLimit is how many extra times a type may re\-enter the walk; omitted it is 1.

<a name="Entry"></a>
## type [Entry](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/spec/spec.go#L13-L19>)

Entry is one documented type, resolved: its structure and its metadata settled once, for every generator to read.

```go
type Entry struct {
    Name   string // display title, and the page's basename
    Slug   string // directory basename, for layouts that give each entry one
    Split  bool   // whether the object fields get pages of their own
    Fields []Field
    Meta   MetadataSource // nil means "no metadata declared"
}
```

<a name="Field"></a>
## type [Field](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/spec/field.go#L30-L43>)

Field describes one documented field: its name, its shape, and the fields nested under it. It carries structure only \- what the field means lives in FieldMeta.

```go
type Field struct {
    YAMLName string
    Kind     Kind
    // TypeName is the struct's name, or a collection's element type. Set even
    // when the recursion limit leaves Children empty, which is what tells a
    // recursive type from a truncated one.
    TypeName     string
    Scalar       string // scalar type for primitives ("string", "int", "bool", "float", "duration", "uint")
    Children     []Field
    OmitEmpty    bool   // yaml:",omitempty"
    Flow         bool   // yaml:",flow"
    MapKeyScalar string // KindDictionary only: scalar type of the map key
    ElemScalar   string // KindList/KindDictionary: scalar type of the element, empty when not a scalar
}
```

<a name="FieldMeta"></a>
## type [FieldMeta](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/spec/meta.go#L15-L47>)

FieldMeta is one field's declared meaning, decoded from the map a Provider returns. Every key is optional; an unknown one is an error naming it, so a typo cannot become silently dead metadata.

```go
type FieldMeta struct {
    Description string   `yaml:"description"`
    Type        string   `yaml:"type"` // human-readable type label; derived from the field when empty
    Required    bool     `yaml:"required"`
    Default     string   `yaml:"default"`
    OneOf       []string `yaml:"oneof"`
    NotOneOf    []string `yaml:"notoneof"`
    Example     string   `yaml:"example"`
    Min         string   `yaml:"min"`
    Max         string   `yaml:"max"`
    Pattern     string   `yaml:"pattern"`
    MinCount    int      `yaml:"mincount"`
    MaxCount    int      `yaml:"maxcount"`
    MinLength   int      `yaml:"minlength"`
    MaxLength   int      `yaml:"maxlength"`
    Unique      bool     `yaml:"unique"`
    Deprecated  string   `yaml:"deprecated"`
    Formats     []string `yaml:"formats"`
    Multiline   bool     `yaml:"multiline"`

    // Structure, declared only by types whose shape reflection cannot read -
    // a union that is a string or an object, for instance. When Kind is set on
    // a Provider's entries, those entries become the type's fields.
    Kind   string `yaml:"kind"`   // "primitive", "object", "list", "dictionary", "variant", "any"
    Scalar string `yaml:"scalar"` // "string", "int", "bool", "float", "uint", "duration"

    // Accepted and ignored: a key another reader of the same Metadata() needs
    // must not be an error here.
    Presentation string `yaml:"presentation"`
    Snippet      string `yaml:"snippet"`
    PreChecked   bool   `yaml:"prechecked"`
    EnablePicker bool   `yaml:"enablepicker"`
}
```

<a name="MetaAt"></a>
### func [MetaAt](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/spec/spec.go#L31>)

```go
func MetaAt(src MetadataSource, sectionPath []string, fieldName string) FieldMeta
```

MetaAt asks src about the field at sectionPath \+ fieldName, joined with dots. A nil source yields a zero FieldMeta, which every consumer reads as "declares nothing".

<a name="GeneratedFile"></a>
## type [GeneratedFile](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/spec/spec.go#L23-L26>)

GeneratedFile records one file written. Path is the file as written, so consumers never have to re\-derive the naming rule.

```go
type GeneratedFile struct {
    Name string // display title, e.g. "Config"
    Path string // path as written, e.g. "docs/reference/config.md"
}
```

<a name="Kind"></a>
## type [Kind](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/spec/field.go#L4>)

Kind classifies a discovered field's shape.

```go
type Kind int
```

<a name="KindPrimitive"></a>

```go
const (
    KindPrimitive  Kind = iota // scalar: string, int, bool, …
    KindObject                 // struct with typed fields
    KindList                   // slice or array
    KindDictionary             // map[K]V
    KindVariant                // union type declared through Metadata
    KindAny                    // interface{}/any
)
```

<a name="MetadataSource"></a>
## type [MetadataSource](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/spec/meta.go#L58-L60>)

MetadataSource answers metadata for a field by its dot\-joined path from the documented type's root \("source", "source.path"\). The root itself is "". A zero FieldMeta means "nothing declared".

```go
type MetadataSource interface {
    FieldMeta(path string) FieldMeta
}
```

<a name="Node"></a>
## type [Node](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/spec/meta.go#L50-L53>)

Node is one field's metadata plus the metadata of its children.

```go
type Node struct {
    FieldMeta `yaml:",inline"`
    Children  map[string]*Node `yaml:"children"`
}
```

<a name="Object"></a>
## type [Object](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/spec/reflect.go#L422-L426>)

Object is one object\-shaped top\-level field of a struct: what it is called in the file, what its Go type is called, and a zero value of that type.

```go
type Object struct {
    YAMLName string
    TypeName string
    Zero     any
}
```

<a name="TopLevelObjects"></a>
### func [TopLevelObjects](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/spec/reflect.go#L431>)

```go
func TopLevelObjects(root any) []Object
```

TopLevelObjects returns the object\-shaped top\-level fields of root. A scalar field, or one whose element is not a struct, is skipped: there is no type to document on its own.

<a name="Options"></a>
## type [Options](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/spec/reflect.go#L24-L31>)

Options tunes a walk.

```go
type Options struct {
    // RecursionLimit is how many extra times a type may re-enter the walk.
    // Zero is the default of 1; use -1 for strict, stopping at the second visit.
    RecursionLimit int
    // Hidden are dot-joined field paths to leave out entirely - of the fields,
    // of the metadata, and so of every generator downstream.
    Hidden []string
}
```

<a name="Provider"></a>
## type [Provider](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/spec/meta.go#L8-L10>)

Provider is implemented by a type that describes its own direct fields, keyed by yaml name. A plain map, so the same method serves any consumer without either side importing the other's types. FieldMeta lists the keys.

```go
type Provider interface {
    Metadata() map[string]any
}
```
